get.summary: The accounts the console may act as, and the one password

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: The id every player-surface read and write names this account by. Same value as the user's id — there is one identity.

nickname.title: Nickname
nickname.description: The whole handle. On a seeded account it is also what the account is *for* — the state it was named for — which is why this roster reads meaning off the address rather than out of the seed catalog.

RosterAccount.title: RosterAccount
RosterAccount.description: One account the console may sign in as.

password.title: Password
password.description: The single password every seeded account holds. **At the top level, never per account**: one password for all of them is the seed system's own decision, and a per-row copy would state the opposite. It is public in this repository's source; the environment gate, not secrecy, is what makes that safe.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Every account on the reserved seed TLD, ordered by address and **unpaginated** — the console filters client-side. An empty list is the honest answer in an unseeded database, and the only answer possible in one holding real players.

RosterResponse.title: RosterResponse
RosterResponse.description: Every account the console may act as, and the one password that does it.

ErrorResponse.description: The body of every error response, on both API surfaces.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable identifier for this exact failure. The only half of the envelope a client may branch on.
code.title: Code

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic. Never the copy shown to a user — that is the client's, chosen from the code.
message.title: Message

trace_id.description: This request's identifier, also returned on the X-Request-ID header. Ties a client-side failure to a server log without logging a payload.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

details.description: Structured context for this code, when the code defines any.
details.title: Details

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
